finest_level: tract (C16001); state for B16001; PUMA via PUMS microdata
categories: C16001: English-only + 12 non-English groups; B16001: 42 groups (state and up); PUMS LANP: 1,333 codes; special 'Detailed languages' tables ~350 languages at nation/state/large county/metro
fallback: ACS PUMS (open microdata, ~2,460 PUMAs) for full language detail; decennial census does not ask language

Since 2016 B16001 is no longer published for counties or tracts (census.gov 2016 table changes, via DOT Title VI toolkit). census.gov API now requires a key.
